Check arguments for an rbiom function against a dataset.

Source: R/fn_schema.r
fn_check.Rd

Applies the checks the function itself would apply on entry, using its fn_schema() entry, without running it. The dataset can be an rbiom object or the summary returned by fn_check_data(), so that a program that only keeps a summary can check requests before passing them on.

Usage

fn_check(fn, args = list(), data)

fn_check_data(biom)

Arguments

fn

The name of a function covered by fn_schema().

args

A named list of the arguments to check, as they would be passed to fn. Arguments not given take their defaults. Arguments marked r_only in the schema can't be given.

data

An rbiom object, or the list returned by fn_check_data() (also after a round trip through JSON).

biom

An rbiom object, or any value accepted by as_rbiom().

Value

fn_check(): the arguments in args, converted as the function would convert them: abbreviations expanded, rank numbers replaced by rank names, layer letters by layer names, metric names by metric ids. A field given with a "==" or "!=" prefix is returned without it, and added to within or between, which are then returned too. An invalid argument is an error, with the message the function would give.

    `fn_check_data()`: a list with `fields` (one entry per
    metadata field, giving its `class`: `"numeric"` or
    `"categorical"`), `ranks` (the rank names), and `tree` (whether
    `biom` has a phylogenetic tree).

Details

Checks cover the type, choices, limits, and number of each value; metadata field names and their classes; ranks; metric names (and whether a phylogenetic metric has a tree); and the constraints in the entry's rules. Deprecated arguments are refused, with what to use instead. Checks that need computed data are left to the function: names in colors, shapes, and patterns against the groups, palette and color names, the parts of a tracks or grid list, and taxa names.

See also

fn_schema()

Examples

    library(rbiom)

    fn_check("adiv_boxplot", list(x = "body", adiv = "shan", layers = "xd"), hmp50)
#> $x
#> [1] "Body Site"
#> 
#> $adiv
#> [1] "shannon"
#> 
#> $layers
#> [1] "box" "dot"
#> 

    data <- fn_check_data(hmp50)
    str(data)
#> List of 3
#>  $ fields:List of 5
#>   ..$ .sample  :List of 1
#>   .. ..$ class: chr "categorical"
#>   ..$ Age      :List of 1
#>   .. ..$ class: chr "numeric"
#>   ..$ BMI      :List of 1
#>   .. ..$ class: chr "numeric"
#>   ..$ Body Site:List of 1
#>   .. ..$ class: chr "categorical"
#>   ..$ Sex      :List of 1
#>   .. ..$ class: chr "categorical"
#>  $ ranks : chr [1:7] ".otu" "Kingdom" "Phylum" "Class" ...
#>  $ tree  : logi TRUE

    fn_check("taxa_boxplot", list(rank = 2, taxa = 3), data)
#> $rank
#> [1] "Phylum"
#> 
#> $taxa
#> [1] 3
#> 

    try(fn_check("adiv_boxplot", list(ci = "zz"), data))
#> Error in validate_var_choices(var = name, choices = choices, env = env,  : 
#>   Invalid `ci` option(s): zz
#> Choices are: ci, range, sd, se, mad
